decisions.rationale: 2025 NOA shows $74,836 and the monthly stub annualizes to about $75,554, supporting the stated $74,000.
Balance of $151,014 with a 3-month history covers the $122,000 down payment, but an unexplained $4,540 e-transfer from J. Roy on 2026/05/07 is not documented.
Meridian Real Estate Appraisers (on the panel) valued the property at $563,000, well below the $610,000 purchase price.
Signed letter on letterhead dated 2026-06-17 confirms permanent full-time employment past probation with salary consistent with the application.
